notes.title: Animated series release!
notes.notes:
Greetings to all players of the 'Enigma Code: Prologue'! 

It's been already 13 month since game publication. 
As you know from the title, this is and has always been only a small part of the full story. And now after almost a year there is good news - the 'Enigma Code' animated series is in active development! 
Also the first episode is already available on youtube.

Best wishes,
C-14

https://youtu.be/PRQeJv9xUJA
